newsitem.title: USA: Environmental Elements sets Wisconsin work.
newsitem.headline: Environmental Elements sets Wisconsin work.

text.p: Environmental Elements Corp said it will service, repair and replace as required Wisconsin Electric's primary and secondary air pollution equipment inventory system-wide for an initial period of at least three years.
Saying the alliance is believed to be one of the first of its kind in the country, EEC said it is the result of over two years of discussions with Wisconsin Energy Corp's principal subsidiary.
The company said it cannot put a specific dollar figure on the alliance with Wisconsin Electric.
"But we are confident it will result in several million dollars in annual volume over the three year period."
With identified professional personnel dedicated to Wisconsin Electric, EEC said, it will engage in a program designed to reduce the life cycle cost of the utility's air pollution control equipment.

"This alliance breaks new ground." said EEC chief executive E. H. Verdery. "Through arrangements such as this, power companies can concentrate on what they do best -- generating electricity -- while being assured that their requirements for technological leadership and environmental stewardship are met in an efficient and cost effective manner."

This alliance will provide Wisconsin Electric the opportunity for life cycle cost reductions while assuring that this critical function will continue to meet operating permit requirements, EEC said. -- Jim Brumm 212-859-1710.
